description: create_note returns to the 笔记 notes-list screen with editor/keyboard dismissed, satisfying the main-list starting state for search_notes_by_keyword.
The created {note_title} (or its content) can be used as the {keyword} input of search_notes_by_keyword so the new note can be located.
Filtered note rows expose note_title and note_content TextViews, whose visible strings can be used as create_note's note_title and note_content inputs.
Creating a note titled {note_title} puts a row with TextView id 'note_title' into the notes list, satisfying open_note_by_title's precondition that a visible entry with that title exists.
The {note_title} produced by create_note is consumed as the note_title input of open_note_by_title.
The detail_title control displays the opened note's title, and that visible title text can be reused as create_note's note_title input; note_content would need another source.
The title displayed in detail_title can be read as non-empty keyword text for a subsequent search_notes_by_keyword call.
Searching filters the notes list so the target note's 'note_title' TextView is visible, satisfying open_note_by_title's precondition.
Filtered note rows expose note_title text, which can supply open_note_by_title's note_title input for a matching result.
Observed after open_note_by_title in trace omninotes-share-1.
The {note_title} and {note_content} produced by create_note supply the title and content inputs required by invoke_share_chooser_for_note.
Filtered rows expose note_title and note_content values that can supply the share function's inputs after opening the note detail.
Opening the note places it on the detail screen with 'detail_title' and 'detail_content' populated, satisfying invoke_share_chooser_for_note's precondition.
The detail_title displayed by open_note_by_title can supply invoke_share_chooser_for_note's note_title input.
Creating the note adds a row containing the 'note_title' control for {target_note} in the active notes list, satisfying archive_note's precondition.
The {note_title} produced by create_note supplies the target_note input of archive_note.
Filtered note rows expose note_title text that can supply archive_note's target_note input.
After archiving, the detail screen and overflow menu are closed and the active notes list with TextView text='笔记' is displayed, satisfying create_note's notes-list starting state.
The postcondition returns to the active main notes list with the detail and overflow menu closed, so the search UI can be opened from the required list state.
Its postcondition returns to the notes-list screen labeled 笔记, providing the visible list screen required as the starting state for sorting.
Opening the note shows the note detail screen with the '更多选项' ImageView whose overflow menu contains '归档', satisfying archive_note's precondition.
The active notes list remains visible after archiving, satisfying the visible list-screen precondition for sorting.
After sorting, the sort menu is dismissed and the list_label view remains visible; for the notes list, this satisfies create_note's required list-screen state.
After sorting, the list view is re-rendered with the sort menu closed, leaving the notes-list screen available for opening the search UI.
The {note_title} produced by create_note supplies the target_note_title input of pin_note.
pin_note ends on the notes-list screen after Back, which provides the list state needed to start create_note.
pin_note returns to the notes-list screen with note rows and search controls available for a new keyword search.
Its postcondition shows the notes-list screen with note_title rows, providing the visible list context needed for sorting.
The note_title control for the pinned note is displayed after pinning, so that title can supply open_note_by_title's note_title input.
The pinned note remains in the active notes list and its displayed title can supply archive_note's target_note input.
Filtered note rows expose note_title text that can supply pin_note's target_note_title input.
The sorted list view is re-rendered on the notes-list screen with note rows still available for opening.
The sorted notes list still presents clickable note rows, satisfying pin_note's notes-list and note-row preconditions.
The sorted active notes list still presents note rows and the note-detail overflow-menu path needed by archive_note.
The {note_title} and {note_content} created by create_note are consumed as the title and first-checklist-item inputs of enable_todo_checklist.
The pinned note title displayed in the postcondition can be used as the search keyword, and the app is back on the notes-list screen.
It returns to the notes list after saving the checklist note, providing the notes-list starting state for create_note.
Its output still displays the note_title and a note_content checkbox-marker preview, which can supply a keyword, and the app is back on the notes-list screen.
It returns to the notes list with the saved note card visible, satisfying the list-screen precondition for sorting.
The notes-list preview still displays the note_title, which can supply open_note_by_title's note_title input.
The notes-list preview displays the note_title for the checklist note, which can supply pin_note's target_note_title input.
The saved checklist note remains in the active notes list and its displayed title can supply archive_note's target_note input.
The saved note still exposes its title and checklist-item text, which can supply share inputs after the note detail screen is opened.
Filtered rows expose note_title and note_content previews, which can supply enable_todo_checklist's title/content inputs when the result is not already a checklist.
The filtered result set is a visible notes-list view with note rows, providing a list screen that can be sorted when the sort control is available.
Observed after delete_note_from_detail_screen in trace omninotes-delete-1.
The {note_title} created by create_note is used as the target_note_title input of delete_note_from_detail_screen.
Creating the note places a row with TextView id 'note_title' showing {note_title} in the notes list, satisfying delete_note_from_detail_screen's precondition.
Creating the note ensures the notes list contains a note whose 'note_title' TextView displays {note_title} with {note_content} in its body, as required by enable_todo_checklist.
Creating the note produces a clickable 'root' row whose 'note_title' is {note_title}, satisfying pin_note's precondition.
Opening the note puts it into the editor where the body can be converted to checklist mode, satisfying enable_todo_checklist's precondition.
Opening the note exposes 'detail_title' and the '更多选项' overflow menu containing '置顶笔记', satisfying pin_note's detail-screen preconditions.
Opening the note shows the detail screen with 'detail_title' displaying the title and the '更多选项' menu containing '删除记事', satisfying delete_note_from_detail_screen's preconditions.
Searching narrows the active notes list so the 'note_title' control for the target note is visible and matchable, supporting archive_note's list precondition.
Searching surfaces a clickable 'root' row with the matching 'note_title', satisfying pin_note's list precondition.
Searching locates the row whose 'note_title' displays the target title, satisfying delete_note_from_detail_screen's list precondition.
